# benchgate

> CI gate for Go benchmark regressions. Compares two `go test -bench` output
> files with real statistics (x/perf benchstat-style) and exits 1 when a
> benchmark got significantly slower. The exit code benchstat never got
> (golang/go#20728).

## Usage

- benchgate OLD NEW compares two `go test -bench=. -count=N` output files (- reads stdin).
- --threshold sets the failing new/old median ratio (default 1.05); --alpha the p-value cutoff (default 0.05).
- --unit picks the measurement unit: ns/op (default), B/op, allocs/op.
- --annotate prints GitHub Actions ::error annotations; --no-fail reports without failing.
- Benchmarks present on only one side are listed, never flagged.
- Exit codes: 0 clean, 1 regression flagged.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/ofershap/benchgate#readme): install, usage, statistics, Q&A
